questions.prompt: Is there a defect in how this code limits order placement per customer? If so, mark the line(s) where it is; otherwise answer that there is none.
A customer placed orders at t=0s, 10s, 20s, 30s and 40s. At t=45s they try again. What is the response?
choices: 201, since the window resets every minute on the clock

questions.prompt: An order passes the limiter but inventory.reserve returns false. How does that affect the customer's limit?
choices: It counts as one of the 5 orders in the window
It is not counted because the order was rejected
It counts double because two repo calls were made

questions.prompt: An attacker sends requests with 500,000 distinct random customerIds. What bounds the limiter's memory?
choices: Nothing; the Map grows to 500,000 entries
Each key's array is cleared after windowMs by a timer
Only the per-key limit of 5 timestamps
maxTrackedKeys: touch() evicts the least recently used key once the Map exceeds 100,000 entries
